title: Elytra Hopper
description: Prevents landing with elytra while holding jump allowing you to hop around and save fireworks!
body:
Elytra Hopper is heavily inspired by [Elytra Recast](https://modrinth.com/mod/elytra-recast), but for Minecraft 26.1.x and 26.2.x.

If/when Elytra Recast updates, you should use it instead!

Features
- After opening your elytra, holding jump keeps it open after landing so you can hop around and build momentum.
- Landing in water can close your elytra so you can swim normally.
- Reduces jump cooldown while holding jump, with a configurable delay from 0 to 10 ticks.
- Includes a JSON config file. 
- Includes Mod Menu support with a vanilla-style config screen.
- Adds optional unbound controls for toggling the mod, recast/hopping, and water-closing behavior.
